annotation.interpretation_a: The receiver is permitted to treat duplicate setting identifiers as a connection error.
annotation.interpretation_b: The receiver is permitted to ignore duplicate setting identifiers without error.
annotation.justification: The use of "MAY" grants the receiver discretion. It is reasonable to interpret this as either erroring on duplicates or ignoring them. There is no constraint forcing one behaviour over the other.
